balls.text: gone! jumps out of the crease, planning to hit it to Noida, but doesn't make any contact as the ball breaks away
nicely bowled, wide of off, creates distance as he premeditates a slog-sweep
clears the front leg, slogs it square on the on side, even though he doesn't get all on it, he gets four
slogged away, flat and low towards deep midwicket, Manhas takes a nice catch low and in front of him
driven inside-out past cover, comes back for two
and he has skied it, a sort of mis-hit as he looks to go down the ground, but he has got enough on it to clear Dilshan at long-on by inches
on the pads, flicked away straight to short fine leg, missed out really, couldn't get it past short fine
yorker outside off, Pollard misses, Tiwary sacrifices his wicket trying to get a bye, and Karthik hits the stumps clean
full and straight, hit down to long-off for one
another full toss, border-line call, not called a beamer
hits this one down to long-off, gets a single
length ball, hit in the air down the ground, dropped by Mishra, and gets four for it
that's a beamer, head-high, even Sehwag gasps
helped away off the pads
goes inside-out, one bounce to sweeper-cover for one, no-ball for a high full toss
comes down the track, yorks himself up, but still places it wide of long-on
comes down the track, gets this full toss too high on the bat and hits down the lap of Dilshan at long-on, another good innings from Rayudu comes to an end
inside out, gets a single to sweeper-cover
low fulltoss, outside off, superbly placed, gets under it and places it wide of long-off
comes down the track, it's a slower ball and hence he ends up dragging it to midwicket
not so lucky here! Tiwary sweeps, Manhas in with a chance to catch it, chooses to go for the catch rather than sit back and wait, misses, gives away four, and it's back-to-back fifties for Tiwary!
another long hop goes unpunished, stays low, and Tiwary misses, Mishra lucky in this over so far
full and wide of leg stump
hit back powerfully, one bounce to Mishra
misses out, long hop, and he fails to get under it, gets just a single
goes for the pull, too full for the shot, gets a single
lovely straight hit, dances down the track and just lofts him, just the extension of arms
slower offcutter, has him fishing for this one, perfect length for a slower ball, can't pull it, can't drive it
mid-on is up in the circle, and he goes deep into the crease, and swats it over him, premeditated but effective
yorker outside off, steered away to third man for one
steps out, mis-hits, gets a single to long-off
another yorker, hit to cover
yorker right away, digs it out for a single
and Rayudu connects well again! jumps out of the crease and lofts it straight down the ground, no frills, good timing
flat delivery again, hit down to long-on for one
pushed through, goes for the slog sweep, gets an inside edge for a single
biffed down the ground, just plain power, and beats long-on
short, angled across him, cut away to deep point
pushes one through into the pads, helped away for a single
shorter, slower, punches it to sweeper-cover for one
gets a thick edge and will come back for a second, wide of third man
low full toss, hit straight to midwicket for one
slogged away, and this time he connects well, and goes way over long-on
slower ball but too wide of off
comes down the track, and mis-hits a pull to midwicket

slogged away, but along the ground, Sehwag puts in the fake slide, Nagar clears up, throws well to the striker's end, but it's too high, Karthik tries for the reverse-flick, misses, and ends up giving the third
pushed through, Tiwary pushes it down to long-on
full, flicked wide of long-on, surprisingly they don't push for two
clean clean strike, dances down the track, gets under a length ball, and clears long-off with ease
flat, quick, hit down to long-off
another wrong'un, pulled to square leg for a single
googly, still goes ahead with the slog-sweep, along the ground, gets a single
length ball, hit powerfully down to long-on, only three of the over, just what Delhi needed
superb yorker, quick, and just outside off
goes full and straight again, and hit down the ground for one
slower ball, and it's called wide as Rayudu misses a flash at it outside off
full and straight, Rayudu looks to come down the track, hits to the right of Sangwan who sticks out his right hand and fields
full on off again, and played to point again
full on off stump, played to point with an open face
quicker flatter delivery, hit back one bounce to Mishra
he is gone! again gets too close to it as he steps out, and doesn't get enough power into it and holes out to long-off. Nagar again takes a neat low catch
full on the pads, helped around the corner for one
comes down the track again, gets too close to it, and flicks it away for a single
how about some good old violence now? dances down and smashes him just to his left, Mishra knows better than to stick his hand out
shot! very nicely placed, no power again, looks to drive a full delivery, then opens the face at the last moment, and gets it between the short third and point
short of a length, chipped down the ground
goes for the wide yorker, Tiwary lets it go, it is just inside the wide lines, Karthik, however, doesn't collect it cleanly
superb shot! full, slightly short of being a yorker, and he opens the face on it, and it flies across the outfield, past point and for four
slower ball, and Tendulkar mis-hits, gets a single to fine leg off the underside edge
comes down the track, nearly yorks himself, gets a single nevertheless
short on off stump, punched to sweeper-cover for one
and what awful start for a new start, full and way down the leg side, Karthik has no chance here, and the fastest 100 of this IPL so far
shorter delivery, quick too, hit back to the bowler
good old-fashioned sweep, makes a good connection, those big strong arms come into play, over deep square leg
googly, does well to open the face on it and place it square of third man
short and pulled down the ground, just a single
full ball, drilled right back at Mishra, one bounce
short delivery, keeps low, shin high, Tiwary gets bat down in time, will take a single
guides this past backward point for a single
the vertical sweep, from in front of leg stump, fine, very fine, Sehwag misfields and Tiwary pushes Tendulkar for three. Fifty up for him! The fastest for Mumbai Indians, in 23 balls
pushes a full delivery towards point, gets a single
down the track again, hits him down the ground and along the ground for a single
short, outside off, opens the face, gets a single
steps down the track and flicks a flat delivery into the leg side for a single
nicely played, uses the angle into the pads, and flicks it between mid-on and midwicket
back of a length, pushed down the ground, gets a single
looks to drive through covers, gets thick edge towards third man
bowled him! Sangwan comes back! Tries the same shot, but this ball is closer to him and he has to make room, and completely plays down the wrong line. Tare misses, Sangwan hits the off stump
takes long-off on, clears the front leg, gets under a length ball, gets enough power in it to clear the fielder
drives a length ball through cover, gets a single
lbw shout as he fails to connect but it is headed down the leg side
no edges this time, he steps out, and lofts it straight and high, clean clean hit, salt meets wound for Ladda

and the leggie almost got Tendulkar! He stepped out of the crease, the break gets a thick edge that is travelling over cover, Mishra runs back and fails to hold on to the overhead catch, and it goes for four too
jumps out of the crease, and hits it to deep midwicket
looks to drive it through covers, finds the fielder, not much turn so far
flat delivery, no turn, gets a leg-bye as he looks to flick it
wide yorker again, gets the toe end of the bat this time, past the keeper
biffs at this length delivery, hits it straight to mid-off
full yorker outside off, makes no connection with this one
and even better connection on this pull shot, smack off the middle of the bat, clearing the front leg, flat into the midwicket boundary
gets a top edge on the pull shot this time, clears the infield, gets two
looks to pull first ball and misses
oof what a shot! square punch, presses forward, reads the slower ball, and opens the face on it, between cover-point and cover, and timing is immaculate
and what a shot, dances down the track, and just meets this slower ball. No violence, just gets inside the line, and guides it wide of mid-on, almost as if playing a spinner

Nagarrrrrr! oh what a catch, will be one of the catches of the tournament by the time we are done with it. Jayasuriya mis-hits a loft over mid-off, the ball seems like it will clear Nagar, who takes a few steps back, leaps at the right time, sticks his right hand behind him and holds on to it
slower ball again, from 129ks to 105ks, gets an edge again, and a single ensues to short third man
quicker ball, gets an edge this time, regulation edge as he looks to drive, but there is no slip
slower ball, driven with an open face, uppishly but wide enough of backward point, four more
pushed to mid-off for a single
driven powerfully down the ground, the 19-year-old Sangwan dives full length to his wrong side and saves three runs
beaten on the short-arm pull again, slightly too fast again
walks across the stumps and flicks him to fine leg for one
steered away for four! waits an extra half-second, opens the face late, beats point, and also manages to hit it square of third man
full ball, hit straight to cover

another run-out missed, Tendulkar walks across the stumps again, misses and wants a quick run, but Jayasuriya hasn't taken a start. AB de Villiers runs in from cover, chooses to go for Jaya's end as opposed to Sachin (he could have got both), and the throw misses by inches. Karthik running in collects it, but is over-balanced and misses the stumps
superb shot, takes half a step down the wicket, gets to the pitch of the slower ball, and guides it past mid-on
tip-and-run to mid-off, and it is perhaps hit too fast and Nagar misses the stumps - Jaya was a goner had he hit
slower ball, 116ks, checks his shot and defends
and the Jaya pick-up shot is in, pitched on a length, on the pads, and he has lofted him over midwicket, wide of deep square leg
length ball, around off, Jayasuriya pushes it to the on side
looks for the pick-up shot from in front of the stumps, but fails to connect. No appeal from Delhi, must have been going down with the angle
misses on the short-arm pull, a bit too fast for the shot this time
and he turns his wrists on it, to beat the off-side field, and drags it from outside off to wide of midwicket, gets three for it
back of a length, 138.6ks, Tendulkar pushes it to cover
and he responds, lovely shot, overpitched and wide, leans into it, opens the face, and guides it between backward point and cover point
full, nearly a yorker, around off, pushes it wide of mid-on for a single
digs it in short, but way down the leg side, Karthik dives full length and saves two wides
it's all over! gets an inside edge as he looks to force it through covers, gets a big inside edge onto the stumps
helps this away, with the turn
beaten while looking to turn it to leg
presses forward and defends
turn and bounce from outside leg, beats him
nudges this off the pads for one
goes deep into the crease to defend
played to extra cover
hit back to cover
opens the face, finds point
called a wide a she misses while trying to run this down to third man
wide of the crease, full, around off, defended
bowled from behind the stumps, slower ball too, beats him
played with an open face to backward point
helped away for a single to deep point
short outside off, left alone
blocks it to cover
worked away off the pads, gets a single
plays inside the line of a ball turning away

poor running and this one is ending fast! drops it just off the wicket and calls Sangwan through, Bravo at point is super fast, swoops on it, and underarm-flicks it to hit the only visible stump direct
big shot down the ground, one bounce to long-on
drives straight to extra cover, sent back and the high throw saves Sangwan
timber! bowled from wide the crease, rolling the fingers on it, Mishra plays the angle, the ball doesn't quite go in with it, and he ends up playing inside the line. Off stump no more
slower ball, ends up playing inside the line as he looks to run it down
flicked away from off stump line, gets a single
slower ball, pushed down to long-on
chipped down the ground for a single
looks for a sharp single to point, but Sathish is very quick
hit down the ground, gets a single
stays low again, pitched outside leg
short ball, hit straight to extra cover
full and wide down the leg side, very difficult for the keeper to collect
defends a length ball back to Jaya
and Jaya gets him! this time he goes for the straight boundary, and Jaya bowls flat and across him, Maharoof swings inside the line, Tare stumps him even though it stays low
Maharoof is having some fun out there, sweeps this off the pads, powerfully and gets four more
fired into the pads, helped away for a single
best shot of the lot, it's chipped inside-out, over extra cover, clears the deep fielder
huge huge six, straight down the ground, Harbhajan gives him slightest of flight and he is onto it in a jiffy
yorks him, no room either
powerful, clean strike down the ground, Maharoof gets four
Mishra steps down and blocks it to point for one
on the pads, and helped away for one
works a full delivery down the ground for one
full, straight and fast, hit back to Jaya
swpt away off the pads, falls just short of Zaheer at deep square leg, had he judged it well, this was a catch
another quick delivery, turns away and beats him outside off
and he strikes first ball! smeared into the pads, Manhas goes for the big shot, is cramped for room, and holes out to long-off
short, cut to deep point, gets a single
full delivery, pushed to mid-on

what a stumping! You can't wipe that laugh off Tare's face! pitches leg, turns away, Karthik is over-balanced, Tare too far from the stumps. And here is the twist, he doesn't try to make it back and remove the bails, he flicks the ball from there, catches Karthik short
goes for the big shot, it is too full and he can't get under it, gets just a single to long-off
full and fast, 101ks, yorks him
late-cuts this offbreak, against the turn, can't get it past short third man
short, turning into the pads, worked away for one
another nice square-cut, won't get four, but hits it wide enough of the deep fielder to come back for two
slower ball again, Maharoof ends up playing inside the line, gets a bye off the fumble from Tare
slower ball, still times it well, driving it to sweeper-cover
make it three fours off three balls for DK, into the pads, and he flicks it straight of deep square leg
and Karthik hits another four! Two balls, two fours! short, takes it from just outside off, and crashes it past point
slower ball, Maharoof pushes it down to long-off for one
gets off the mark with four right away, cuts this short delivery left of point and right of third man
bowled him! played on! Bravo and Pollard break into a dance! looks to cut this one, but it is perhaps too close to him, and he chops it on, he has been struggling with that cut shot
short, steered way to third man for one
slower ball, and Maharoof has to check his shot, ends up playing it back to Bravo
sliding into the pads, misses out, gets just one leg-bye
Sehwag is gone! takes on the long-off fielder, gets under a back-of-a-length delivery and gets the toe end of the bat, and holes out. Big wicket
normal pace, still slightly early into the intended shot over mid-off, gets a single to long-on
slower ball, Sehwag clears the front leg and is way too early into the shot
short, sliding down the leg side, and he helps it past short fine leg, easy does it
short, pulled down the ground, just a single
offcutter, cramps him up, gets a dot ball
short, into the body, Sehwag is early into the pull but it lands safely
and he drills one straight to mid-off, gets a single off the fumble from Zaheer
hits straight to extra cover this time
extra-cover punch, just back of a length and splits mid-off and extra cover
it would be harsh to call it a drop, shortish delivery, gets an underside edge into Tare's pads
short and wide again, and he misses this one completely
short and wide, cut straight to Tendulkar at cover
low full toss again, but this time he finds deep square leg
yorker, nay slightly fuller of being one, and he times it perfectly, past midwicket

Malinga exults, roars! slower ball here, and Dilshan sees the short ball and gives it his everything into the pull shot, he is through the shot long before the ball arives and his off stump goes for a cartwheel
yorker, fast and straight, just outside leg, Dilshan gets outside the line and fails to connect
lovely shot, full and wide of off, Dilshan doesn't go for power, opens face, and gets it between point and third man
slower ball, yorker, Sehwag's but turns in his hand and he gets a single
into the hips again, worked away to deep square leg for one
on a length, on the pads, and lofted wide of mid-on
worked fine off the hips, but straight to short fine leg, Tiwary, Sehwag is sent back, and Sehwag just about makes back. Direct hit would have got him
misses on the pick-up shot over leg, gets a leg-bye
back of a length, worked away off the hips to deep square leg
back of a length, around off, pushed to cover for one
yorker outside off, and they sneak another single to cover-point
slower ball, adjusts his shot, still ends up dragging it to leg side, gets a single
shot! V I R U! just inches short of being a yorker, and driven past Malinga, along the ground, down the ground, and what power in it
back to yorking him, Dilshan digs it out and he pinches a single to point
slower ball, there is No Country for Bowlers! He has done him in, got an early shot out of him, got an inside edge, and that goes to the fine-leg boundary
pitched up, wide of off, Dilshan throws his arms at it, misses, and it is called a wide
starts off with a yorker outside off, can't do much with it
pitched up on pads, and it's criminal with the fine leg up in the circle, Sehwag helps himself

my word, Sathish is some sort of an electric fence, full length dive to his length at backward point, and then he hits the stumps direct while being off balance. Dilshan makes it, but he has saved three runs
short, worked away off the hips for a single
slightly slower delivery, he opens the face as late as possible, gets it wide of keeper but fine of third man, gets a couple
length, angling across, hit powerfully wide of mid-off, gets a single
and he goes for the surprise delivery pitched up outside off, and Dilshan smashes it over mid-off
